Fix the header nav overlapping the logo on narrow screens: below the tablet breakpoint it now collapses into a hamburger-triggered dropdown menu
Add a contact-form module (src/modules/kontaktni_formular) with a /kontakt page and nav link: subject + message, plus a required reply-to email when signed out
Add sun/moon icons to the light/dark toggle switch's thumb, matching whichever mode is active

Give the site its own playful "geometric confetti" visual identity: a warm paper background with scattered accent shapes, hard-outlined cards, Poppins headings, and a teal/mustard/coral palette across the nav, footer, home page, and article/page views

Upgrade the WYSIWYG editor: headings 1-5, font size/family/color, underline/strikethrough, and a link dialog (editable text + URL) for both inserting and editing links, including ones created via @-mention - links now render underlined by default
Add filter and sortable columns (title/heading, status, event date) to the admin Pages and Articles lists
Add full-text search to the home page (title/short_description/event_date), replacing the dashboard view with results while a query is active
Add a browsable event calendar to the home page (desktop: right sidebar; mobile: expand-to-full-screen button), marking days with published, in-window articles and linking to them on hover/click
Move page URLs to root level (/o-projektu instead of /stranka/o-projektu), reject page slugs colliding with an existing route, and render published show_in_nav pages in the site nav
Fix 4 high-severity dependency vulnerabilities (react-router-dom CSRF bypass, postcss/nanoid via vite) via npm audit fix — patch-level updates only, no API changes
Rebuild the home page as a dashboard: nearest upcoming article, pinned articles, and the last 5 non-pinned past articles, each linking to its own /clanek/:slug page
Add public /stranka/:slug and /clanek/:slug routes for admin-authored Pages and Articles

Add a sitewide footer (linking to withfbraun.com before the copyright line) pinned to the bottom of the viewport even on short pages

Add a pluggable feature-module system: self-contained modules under src/modules/ are auto-discovered and toggled on/off per application via public/modules.json, contributing their own routes, nav links, and translations
Add light/dark theme toggle in the header, with the preference synced to the signed-in user's profile (user_data.darkMode) and a dedicated Appearance section on the Account page
